summary: This directory manages business calendar operations, providing mechanisms to calculate business days, identify holidays, and handle market-specific date adjustments. It acts as the central interface for temporal business logic within the application.
responsibilities: Define interfaces for business day calculations
Provide access to market-specific calendar services
Perform adjustments for month-end and year-end dates
relationships: The BusinessCalendar interface defines the standard operations for date calculations.
The BusinessCalendarService manages the retrieval and availability of specific calendar configurations based on the market.
designDecisions: Use of service-based abstraction to decouple calendar lookups from specific date calculations
Interface-driven design to allow for multiple calendar implementations per market
